query: Display nucleotide characters at their genomic positions as text marks, with each base letter colored distinctively across the hg38 assembly from H3K27ac-resgen.multivec.

spec.title: H3K27ac-resgen.multivec across hg38
spec.subtitle: Available rendering from the requested dataset: row-stratified H3K27ac signal by sample
spec.description: The original request asked for nucleotide characters as colored text marks, but the inspected H3K27ac-resgen.multivec dataset does not contain nucleotide/base identities. This view now accurately presents the available data from that dataset: H3K27ac signal across hg38, stratified by sample.

https://resgen.io/api/v1/tileset_info/?d.explanation: Multi-sample quantitative signal, served as tiles by a HiGlass/resgen tileset server.
